title: Transepithelial Iontophoresis-Assisted Cross Linking for Progressive Keratoconus: Up to 7 Years of Follow Up

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) license, link https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

groups.description: Transepithelial iontophoresis-assisted CXL (0.1% riboflavin with enhancers, iontophoresis 1 mA for 5 min, UVA 10 mW/cm2 for 9 min, 5.4 J/cm2) for progressive keratoconus, 19 eyes of 19 patients, prospective single centre, Rozzano (Milan) 2013-2014, follow-up up to 84 months. Procedure described as cross-linking only.

decision: excluded: corrected acuity is reported only as Snellen (decimal) means

exclusions.what: Table 1 (jcm-11-00678-t001) CDVA at baseline and 6-84 months
exclusions.reason: unit: the Results state that CDVA data are expressed in Snellen; the table prints means of Snellen (decimal) acuity, which are not admissible (protocol inclusion 2); no logMAR or ETDRS letter series is reported

notes: Kmax, thinnest point, aberrations and the ABCD progression values (Table 1) are mentioned here only.
No record is written: the study has no admissible series under extraction protocol 1.0.0 and the extraction brief.
